games.name: Duke Nukem 3D
games.description: Alien invaders, outrageous weapons, and attitude to spare. Blast through Los Angeles streets, space stations, and secret-filled strongholds as Earth’s wisecracking one-man army. Shrink enemies, set pipe-bomb traps, and strap on a jetpack to reach hidden routes. Interactive scenery, inventive weapons, and explosive firefights make exploration as entertaining as clearing the next room.

games.name: Time Crisis II
games.description: Take cover. Reload. Beat the clock. Dive into Namco's explosive arcade shootout, where quick aim and split-second timing keep you in the fight. Mouse-ready action, fullscreen arcade atmosphere and free play - no pockets full of coins required. Bring your own timecrs2.zip for MAME 0.289. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher.

games.name: Marvel Infinity War
games.description: ZVitor's Marvel beat 'em up with the tested native OpenBOR 6391 runtime in its own build-specific folder, fullscreen, CRT and controller preset. Download the pinned game directly from ZVitor or supply the matching PAK. Upgrades keep existing settings and progress. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher.

games.name: Ultimate Double Dragon 3
games.description: The fan-made Ultimate Double Dragon beat 'em up on the tested native OpenBOR 6391 runtime, with the captured fullscreen, shader and controller preset. Bring your own exact UDD_3.0.pak; no download. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher.

games.name: Star Wars Trilogy Arcade
games.description: Stay on target. Fullscreen mouse-aim setup with an owner-confirmed Free Play seed, portrait art, screenshot and video. Existing NVRAM is preserved. Bring swtrilgy.zip. Requires the current privately supplied Momentum launcher; new-package gameplay confirmation remains separate.

games.name: The House of the Dead 2
games.description: Fullscreen mouse-lightgun setup with an absent-only right-click reload preset, portrait art, screenshot and video. Tested Flycast reuse or separately approved isolated fallback; personal mappings and saves stay intact. Bring USA CUE and matching BIN tracks. Requires the current privately supplied Momentum launcher.

games.name: Brutal Doom
games.description: Brutal Doom v21, Brutal Voxel Doom 2.0 Complete and Doom Metal Volume 5 in the tested load order. Bring DOOM2.WAD. Tested UZDoom reuse or separately approved isolated fallback; existing profiles preserved. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher.

games.name: Brutal Doom 64
games.description: Brutal Doom 64 with gameplay, maps, announcer and music in the tested four-file load order. Bring DOOM2.WAD. Tested UZDoom 5.0.1 reuse or separately approved isolated fallback; existing profiles preserved. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher. Gameplay confirmation remains required.

games.name: Quake - Slave Zero X: Episode Enyo
games.description: Six-level Quake campaign with fullscreen startup. Bring Quake id1/pak0.pak and pak1.pak. Reuse verified Enyo files or approve a direct publisher download; no mod files bundled. Requires an up-to-date Momentum launcher.

games.name: L.A. Machineguns
games.description: Fullscreen mouse aiming with an owner-confirmed working Free Play/calibration seed, portrait art, screenshot and video. Existing NVRAM is preserved. Bring Japan lamachin.zip. Requires the current privately supplied Momentum launcher; new-package gameplay confirmation remains separate.

games.name: Virtua Cop 2
games.description: Mouse-aimed Virtua Cop 2 on Flycast v2.7, now with an absent-only right-click reload preset, portrait art, screenshot and video. Existing mappings and saves are preserved. Bring the Japanese GDI and all 39 matching tracks. Requires the current privately supplied Momentum launcher.
